windows.retrospective_exploratory: every season before 2026 and 2026 weeks 1-4 (already read by earlier work; never an untouched holdout)
windows.prospective_confirmation: 2026 week >= 5, decision clock explicit-offset and strictly before kickoff, immutable capture sha256 present
windows.excluded_late: decision clock at/after kickoff: counted, never scored as forecast evidence
windows.unknown_clock: no machine decision clock (e.g. hand-graded chat cards): counted, never prospective

separations: forecast calibration (Brier, log loss, ECE, reliability, per-market n, game-cluster bootstrap)
hypothetical ROI at actual offered prices only (null without a price receipt)
actual account P/L (null without a ticket ledger)
protocol.multiplicity: Holm across all candidates screened in one run, familywise alpha 0.05, one-sided game-cluster bootstrap p = P(delta Brier >= 0)
protocol.uncertainty: cluster bootstrap resampling whole games (primary) and season-weeks (protocol paired unit); 4000 reps; seed 20261006; unavailable below 5 clusters
protocol.line_policy: edge evaluation only at real lines (offered receipts or public consensus closing lines) with native final outcomes; no synthetic line is edge evidence; line-free projection checks are labelled separately
protocol.no_production_effect: no candidate result changes a production weight, calibration, default, or delivered card; a screening pass only makes a candidate eligible for prospective confirmation
protocol.retirement: a failed screen retires the candidate as implemented; reopen only with a documented change in mechanism, target, data or access and a new candidate_id

criteria.mechanism: A team entering a game in a QB-role change state (previous game's leading passer differs from the season-to-date primary passer, or the primary is Out/Doubtful on that week's official injury report) produces fewer points than the closing total prices.
criteria.signal: m1_signal = number of teams in the game in a QB-change state (0, 1, 2); computed only from games strictly before the target game and the pregame injury report
criteria.baseline: market: P(over) = 0.5 at the real public closing total (nflverse schedules total_line)
criteria.challenger: P(over) = clip(0.5 + beta * m1_signal, 0.02, 0.98); beta = no-intercept least squares of (y_over - 0.5) on m1_signal over the fit seasons
criteria.outcome: native final total (home_score + away_score); push = total == total_line, excluded and counted

screening_gate.rule: S1 sample AND S2 Holm-adjusted game-cluster p < 0.05 AND S2b season-week-cluster 95% upper bound of dBrier < 0 AND S3 dLogLoss < 0 AND S4 fitted beta has the mechanism sign

criteria.prospective_gate: if screened eligible: beta refit on 2024+2025 and frozen; 2026 weeks >= 5 with pre-kickoff captures; >= 150 graded games; same S2/S3 rules; else INCONCLUSIVE
criteria.known_limits: offseason QB changes before week 1 are not flagged (prior-season leader is both primary and last); Doubtful QBs sometimes play; no price receipt in the source, so ROI is not computed

criteria.mechanism: As-of opponent-adjusted scoring form (each offence's points scored and the opposing defence's points allowed over their last 8 completed games, shrunk n/(n+4) toward the strictly-prior league mean) carries information the closing total does not.
criteria.signal: m2_signal = asof_expected_total - total_line (points); asof_expected_total = (off_home + def_away)/2 + (off_away + def_home)/2 from games strictly before kickoff
criteria.baseline: market: P(over) = 0.5 at the real public closing total
criteria.challenger: P(over) = clip(0.5 + beta * m2_signal, 0.02, 0.98); beta = no-intercept least squares of (y_over - 0.5) on m2_signal over the fit seasons
criteria.outcome: native final total; pushes excluded and counted; games without as-of form for both teams are counted as signal_missing

screening_gate.rule: S1 sample AND S2 Holm-adjusted game-cluster p < 0.05 AND S2b season-week-cluster 95% upper bound of dBrier < 0 AND S3 dLogLoss < 0 AND S4 fitted beta has the mechanism sign

criteria.prospective_gate: if screened eligible: beta refit on 2024+2025 and frozen; 2026 weeks >= 5 with pre-kickoff captures; >= 150 graded games; same S2/S3 rules; else INCONCLUSIVE
criteria.known_limits: game-level form only (no player opportunity); points include defensive/special-teams scores; no price receipt, so ROI is not computed
